reactor_type: horizontal bed cold wall APCVD reactor
evidence: The temperature of the substrate was carefully monitored during deposition and films were grown at 300, 350, 400, 445 and 500 °C. The glass was heated by four Whatman cartridge heaters that were inserted into a flat bed graphite block. The rig was designed so that six independent gas lines could be utilized. The nitrogen-diluted SnCl4 stream and H2S streams (0.3 L min–1) were mixed by using concentric pipes of 1/4 inch and 1 inch diameter.
